chose: Mochi's quiz (#3620) is built at rung 3, and only as members of closed unions that already exist. A round is a grouping of conversation/2's turns (the question, the owner's take, Tin Bird's verdict turn) whose outcome is a closed set (right, partly, wrong). Lives are a pure fold over the outcomes in order, never stored, and they never end the essay, since every round plays. The buzz is a buzzer member of SOUNDS, synthesised like the other cues. The lightning is a shock member of Mochi's CEREMONIES, played at most once a chapter, when a subject's last life goes. Lives and the round on screen are a tally template of the game-card burn-in. The question on screen is HOST15's question card (#3557). The landscape is one new ground design. The thumbnail is thumbnail.ts's template (C1028). What is ours: the answer of record comes from the repositories' code at a pinned commit (claims.ts), and the owner's answers are their own takes.
options: Members of the existing unions: conversation/2's rounds, SOUNDS, CEREMONIES, game-card templates, the cards union, a ground design (chosen)
A quiz module of its own, with its own record, scoring, sounds and card
